description: Microzonazione sismica - Comuni che dispongono di uno studio is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by rischi.protezionecivile.gov.it. Dataset generated from the mosaic of seismic microzonation (MS) studies carried out by municipalities as part of planning activities or the implementation of the national plan for the prevention of seismic risk (Law 77/2009).MS studies carried out in implementation of the national plan for the prevention of seismic risk, prepared in accordance with the national ... Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Seismic microzonation - municipalities that have a study" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include RNDT. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
